_comment: Machine-readable parameters of this framework for tools/urf.py. Keep them consistent with framework/FRAMEWORK.md. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

id._collision: Optional, with identity.strict_secondary_key: template for the ID of an entry whose derived ID is held by an entry with another secondary key, using {id} and {sk}. The pattern must accept it. Without it such a candidate cannot be added.

secondary_key: <field holding a stable source identifier, or null>

identity._strict_secondary_key: true: two different known secondary keys are always two entries; a name or derived ID never merges them.

item_required: <framework item fields required for a verified item>
historical_keep: <identity fields kept when an item becomes inactive>

<coverage key>._completion: Checks a recorded operation must pass to count as complete: [field, '==' or '>=', value | '$field' | {'min': ['$a', '$b']}]. Reaching a depth limit is never completion on its own.

defer._reconsider_days: Days a deferred lead waits before it is queued again; omit to require an explicit until.
